RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  July 28, 2010/Sravana 6, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
13
Meeting of intelligence chiefs of India
and Pakistan
*41. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  chiefs of intelligence
agencies of India and Pakistan held a meeting
as a part of the cooperation to fight
terrorism and dealt with security issues;
and
(b) whether according to a Minister of
Pakistan, both India and Pakistan have
agreed that  the agencies of two countries
would be working together to prevent any
repeat of Mumbai attack?
IAF crashes due to human error
*42. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: Will the Min ister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has admitted
that a large number of IAF crashes have
taken place due to human error;
(b) if so, whether Government has since
contemplated any steps to provide
adequate training to pilots to check such
IAF crashes; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Revamping of Rashtriya Swasthya
Bima Yojana
*43. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is in the process of revamping the Rashtriya
Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) so as to
extend the same to unorganized sector;
(b) if so, the details of the proposed
change;
(c) whether Government is planning to
add more categories like autorickshaw and
taxi drivers, rag pickers, etc., under RSBY;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

14
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Establishment of a solar plant near
Air-Force training base in
Jaisalmer
†*44. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
private company of Uttar Pradesh is going
to set up a solar plant within one kilometer
range of Chandhan training and firing range
for vital fighter aircrafts of Air Force in
Jaisalmer;
(b) whether Government proposes to
acquire the land purchased by the company
near such a vital military base; and
(c) whether permission has been
obtained from  the  Ministry  to set up this
plant before allotment of this land?
Foreign capital investment in retail
market
†*45. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal is
being considered by Government to give
foreign capital investment a free access to
the retail market of the country;
(b) if so, the outlines of the proposal;
(c) whether there is any compulsion on
the part of Government to permit foreign
capital investment in the retail market of
the country; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard  and
the reasons for this compulsion?
SAARC Home Ministers meet
*46. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether meeting of South Asian
Association for Regional Co-operation
(SAARC) Home Ministers attended by
Home Minister in the last week of June,
2010 resulted in positive development
which will push Pakistan to address terror,
including legal framework under which India
can demand handing over of persons like
LeT founder Hafiz Saeed in the absence of
an extradition treaty;
(b) if so, whether India has managed to
get Abu Salem from Portugal as both nations
were party to UN Convention for the
suppression of terrorist bombings; and
(c) if so, to what extent this SAARC
meeting has helped India for extradition of
people involved in terrorist activities in
India?
Need to overhaul anti-naxal strategy
*47. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether lack  of coordination
between the State Police and Central
Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has led to a
rise in attacks by naxalites in the past few
months;
(b) if so, whether the anti-naxal strategy
needs immediate overhaul;
(c) if so, whether the Union Government
has recently asked the naxal-affected States,
particularly Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand,
to follow Andhra Model to counter
naxalites; and
(d) if so, the reaction of the naxal-
affected States?

15
Naxalite movement gaining
momentum
*48. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that naxalites
movement has been gaining momentum in
West Bengal, Chhattisgarh, Bihar,
Jharkhand etc. and  naxals have been
targetting  security forces by killing them,
keeping them in captivity and snatching
their fire arms;
(b) if so, the details thereof and major
incidents of the last two years;
(c) the number of incidents with details
of cases in which naxalites freed their
members from the custody of police; and
(d) what Government has done to boost
the morale of security forces in their fight
against naxalites?
